name: Grok 4.5
short: SpaceXSI's Cursor-co-trained reasoning model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work; 500K context with text/image input. Grok 4.7 is now xAI's newest flagship.
contextWindow: 500,000 context (500K; OpenCode catalog lists up to 500K output)
modalities: Text and image in; text out
pricingNote: $2/$6 per 1M input/output below 200K prompt; $4/$12 at 200K+; cached input $0.30/$0.60
standout: Co-trained with Cursor; the vendor model card reports 15,954 average output tokens per SWE-Bench Pro task versus 67,020 for Opus 4.8 Max (4.2× fewer in that run).
tradeoff: Paid API; prompts at or above 200K incur doubled token rates. Text/image input only, and Grok 4.7 is now the recommended flagship.
